[B1] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' Cloud
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B2] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'delegateAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > .
[B3] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX, Rest), 'key' : Key, ...) , ... > .
[B4] < SmartThingsCloud | Device : ('key' : Key, 'trusted' : Trusted, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'provideKey' SmartThingsCloud | (Device ; Key)
=> < SmartThingsCloud | Device : ('key' : Key, 'trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), ...) , ... > .
[B5] < Device | ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' Device
=> < Device | ... > .
[B6] < Cloud | Device : ('state' : 'off', 'trusted' : (P, Rest), ...) , ... > $ P 'toggle' Device
=> < Cloud | Device : ('state' : 'on', 'trusted' : (P, Rest), ...) , ... > $ Cloud 'turnOn' Device .
[B7] < SmartThingsCloud | Device : ('linkedLock' : Lock, ...) , ... > $ SmartThingsCloud 'turnOn' Device
=> < SmartThingsCloud | Device : ('linkedLock' : Lock, ...) , ... > $ SmartThingsCloud 'turnOn' Lock .
[B8] < Lock | 'trusted' : (P, Rest), 'state' : 'off', ... > $ P 'turnOn' Lock
=> < Lock | 'trusted' : (P, Rest), 'state' : 'on', ... > .
